text:
Four students describe the phrase ‘absolute zero’ during a lesson on the particle model.
Which student is correct?
A
This is the lowest possible temperature.
B
Particles in a solid start vibrating.
C
Particles do not have any weight.
D
Particles have the least gravitational potential energy.

options.label: A
options.text: This is the lowest possible temperature.

options.label: B
options.text: Particles in a solid start vibrating.

options.label: C
options.text: Particles do not have any weight.
